findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "message" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_support_tickets, reply_to_ticket, get_ticket_thread, get_customer_details, get_feed_inventory · Private data: list_vehicles, get_support_tickets, get_feature_requests, get_ticket_thread, get_hatches, log_varroa_treatment, get_tasks, get_calendar_events, get_orders, get_customer_details, get_meat_inventory, get_beekeeping_apiary, get_financial_pnl, get_feed_inventory, get_vendors_and_pos, get_egg_collections · Public sink: create_feature_request, get_customer_details · Destructive: get_orders, delete_task, delete_calendar_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_support_tickets, reply_to_ticket, get_ticket_thread, get_customer_details, get_feed_inventory · Private data: list_vehicles, get_support_tickets, get_feature_requests, get_ticket_thread, get_hatches, log_varroa_treatment, get_tasks, get_calendar_events, get_orders, get_customer_details, get_meat_inventory, get_beekeeping_apiary, get_financial_pnl, get_feed_inventory, get_vendors_and_pos, get_egg_collections · Public sink: create_feature_request, get_customer_details · Destructive: get_orders, delete_task, delete_calendar_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
